selection.name: Dagu (C03)
selection.role: Conditional scheduler choice for command-based local workflows: scheduling, visible run history, retries, stop/retry CLI and authenticated MCP. Pair with configured Linux supervision; detached-descendant cancellation remains unqualified.
selection.install_source: README and installer help at v2.18.1, commit 3bb5b23d2b0b3b924dd6eafc4c04107baa9cafc7.

basis.shows: Existing shell/container workflows, local file-backed history, scheduling, CLI controls and built-in MCP; one binary without an external database.
Documented version selection and supported systemd service installation. The generated service starts dagu start-all; it does not configure resource caps.
Release published 2026-09-29; Linux amd64 and macOS arm64 binaries.
Default-branch commit dated 2026-10-02; fixes a flaky graceful-stop test. Repository metadata reports unarchived.
Latest inspected main-branch CI run completed successfully.
Latest inspected main-branch conformance run completed successfully; no cross-candidate superiority follows.
Existing test checks original-process-group cleanup after parent death; it does not test descendants escaping through setsid.
Resource enforcement is explicitly best effort: failure warns and execution continues.
Linux cgroup-v2 CPU/memory limits require accessible cgroups; cleanup does not terminate remaining cgroup processes.

selection.name: systemd (C05)
selection.role: Linux supervision component: configured PID/CPU/memory/runtime bounds, service-cgroup cancellation, restart policy and persistent journal. Native macOS is unsupported; effect recovery remains application-specific.
selection.install_command: sudo apt-get update -y && sudo apt-get install systemd systemd-sysv -y
selection.install_source: Official Microsoft WSL installation instructions. systemd's own v262 README also documents Linux source installation with meson setup, ninja and sudo meson install after prerequisites.

basis.shows: Supported WSL2 setup and Ubuntu/Debian package command; systemd services do not themselves keep WSL alive.
Upstream Linux requirements, build/install/test commands and regularly tested amd64/arm64 architectures.
Default KillMode=control-group terminates the unit's remaining processes, escalating after the stop timeout.
OS-enforced TasksMax, CPUQuota and MemoryMax controls; explicit configuration is necessary.
Persistent journal configuration preserves visible service logs across restarts.
Existing integration assertions exercise termination of a service inside a nested cgroup.
Regression assertions verify PID-limit configuration survives daemon reload.
Recent coverage workflow completed successfully; its source runs integration tests.
Latest inspected build-test workflow failed on 2026-09-16; cause and release applicability were not investigated.
Release published 2026-09-22.
Default-branch commit dated 2026-10-01; repository metadata reports unarchived.

not_selected.name: conductor
not_selected.reason: Current and unarchived: v3.32.5 released September 25, default-branch commit October 1. Durable worker orchestration and recovery tests are credible, but local process-tree containment and a target-workload advantage remain unqualified; external effects require idempotent workers under its documented [at-least-once semantics](https://github.com/conductor-oss/conductor/blob/602bf6e97b9b9a4121fc2ef77156a33bf44b582c/docs/architecture/durable-execution.md).

not_selected.name: Prefect
not_selected.reason: Close alternative for Python workflows; current and unarchived, with 3.8.7 released September 26 and a default-branch commit October 1. [Cancellation depends on execution infrastructure](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/blob/686d93ee93b8f44abe935e4a00cf80349990b9a5/docs/v3/advanced/cancel-workflows.mdx), and result persistence needs configuration. The inspected [main-branch unit-test run failed](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/actions/runs/36903337533); its cause is unknown, so this alone does not establish inferiority.

not_selected.name: Dagster
not_selected.reason: Current and unarchived: 1.13.25 and the latest default-branch commit are dated October 1. Strong asset-oriented orchestration with multiprocessing and monitoring tests, but persistent local storage requires setup and [DefaultRunLauncher lacks worker-crash detection](https://github.com/dagster-io/dagster/blob/a69038cd47003200a1c8fc3540b5855c6d93746e/docs/docs/deployment/execution/run-monitoring.md); no measured advantage for this requirement was established.

not_selected.name: pg_durable
not_selected.reason: Current and unarchived: v0.2.8 released September 11, default-branch commit October 1. Its [README](https://github.com/microsoft/pg_durable/blob/0ba88f3cfbf9d4422fd2399c226ea7952bba41a1/README.md) identifies predominantly external workflows as a poor fit; preview-stage SQL orchestration is narrower than general local-command supervision despite a relevant published [upgrade/replay evaluation](https://github.com/microsoft/pg_durable/blob/0ba88f3cfbf9d4422fd2399c226ea7952bba41a1/docs/upgrade-testing.md).

not_selected.name: Temporal
not_selected.reason: Current and unarchived: v1.32.0 released September 11, default-branch commit October 2. Strong durable-workflow finalist with [passing inspected All Tests CI](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/actions/runs/36952856845) and documented WSL2 development, but the packet does not establish a need for its server/SDK/worker model or qualify OS process-tree containment and operating cost.

not_selected.name: Restate
not_selected.reason: Current and unarchived: v1.7.13 released October 1, default-branch commit October 1. Durable invocation history, retries and [cancellation tests](https://github.com/restatedev/restate/blob/08a6f25b8f6ae74557d0fa78d8cdc1b1c22e92cd/crates/worker/src/partition/state_machine/tests/kill_cancel.rs) support application workflows; local OS-process bounds and target-host operating cost remain unqualified. It remains a durable-workflow finalist.

layers.deciding_comparison: Compare Dagu+systemd against Prefect+systemd on the actual WSL2 workload with equal persistence, retry, resource and concurrency settings. Test scheduler/worker crashes, reboot during waits, cancellation with detached descendants, and a crash after an external effect commits but before acknowledgement. Measure surviving processes, duplicate/lost effects, retained history, recovery latency, resource use and operator steps. If host-loss recovery or durable long waits are required, qualify Temporal against Restate under those same cases before selecting a durable engine. The packet's unequal recovery comparison names no winner.
evidence_gaps: The packet does not specify workload language, effect semantics or required wait/recovery duration. Dagu is a conditional choice for command workflows; the evidence does not settle Dagu versus Prefect for all local workloads.
No fair cross-candidate measured superiority was established. Existing suites and observed CI conclusions are evidence of tested coverage, not comparative performance.

Source verification corrected the initial uncertainty about Dagu: its CPU/memory guard is per DAG run and best effort; cancellation targets the original process group. Detached descendants are not covered by that mechanism. systemd whole-service cancellation does not establish independent per-run cancellation.

The selected composition has not been tested on the target host. Explicit cgroup caps, persistent history and application idempotency/checkpoints are required; a default installation does not establish recoverable external effects.
Dagu ships macOS arm64 binaries, but its native CPU/memory guard is unsupported on macOS. systemd requires Linux. Equivalent bounded-tree supervision on native macOS remains unresolved.

Linux install paths were verified for every candidate. Temporal and Restate provide Darwin arm64 release assets; Conductor provides Linux arm64 containers; Prefect and Dagster document Mac installation. pg_durable's macOS arm64 support remains unverified. This layer needs no GPU.

All eight repositories are unarchived and have releases and default-branch commits within the 90-day window beginning 2026-07-04. Issue-resolution responsiveness was not established. Dagu has an open queue-scheduling report, whose behavior was not reproduced: https://github.com/dagucloud/dagu/issues/2970.
Current CI conclusions were sampled for Dagu, systemd, Prefect and Temporal. Conductor, Dagster, pg_durable and Restate test sources were inspected, but current CI outcomes were not verified.

Restate's current BSL-1.1 license is source-available rather than an Open Source license; this is information only and did not determine its disposition: https://github.com/restatedev/restate/blob/08a6f25b8f6ae74557d0fa78d8cdc1b1c22e92cd/LICENSE.

Public pinned Git snapshots/archives supplied README, documentation and test evidence instead; the requested ctx-fetch/search method could not be completed.
